You see the breath gathering for a shout and move before the warning comes.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Speech restriction lasts until the end of the target’s next turn; damage is immediate.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Strike before the warning can leave its mouth. Requires melee weapon. The silence blocks speech, not spells or abilities that do not require speech.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
4 physical damage; the target cannot speak until the end of its next turn.
Strong
6 physical damage and the same silence.
